result.topic_en: Corollaries on the vibrating elastic rod: the roots of the frequency equation are approximately ω = 3ϱ, 5ϱ, 7ϱ, … (odd multiples), so the simple sounds go as 9, 25, 49, 81, … and the first overtone lies an octave plus a tritone above the fundamental, a harsh dissonance.

Corollarium 3.
§. 18. Progrediamur ad quintum quadrantem, et
manifestum est hic iterum dari valorem tantillo minorem
quam $5\varrho$; defectus enim aliquot minuta prima non exce-
det. Porro vero sextus et septimus vacui manebant; in
octavo autem reperietur $\omega = 7\varrho$, tam prope vt excessus
sentiri nequeat; sicque valores vlteriores erunt continuo

Corollarium 4.
§. 19. Quod si ergo in primo valore exiguum
discrimen vnius gradus negligamus, omnes valores anguli $\omega$
erunt $3\varrho$, $5\varrho$, $7\varrho$, $9\varrho$, $11\varrho$, etc. qui secundum numeros
impares in infinitum progrediuntur, vnde nostra virga in-
finitos sonos simplices edere poterit, qui sequentibus nu-
meris exprimentur:
$\frac{9\varrho c\sqrt{2gb}}{2aa}$; $\frac{25\varrho c\sqrt{2gb}}{2aa}$; $\frac{49\varrho c\sqrt{2gb}}{2aa}$; $\frac{81\varrho c\sqrt{2gb}}{2aa}$; etc.
qui ergo soni secundum numeros, 9, 25, 49, 81 etc. pro-

proximus vero ad hunc rationem tenebit vt $25:9$, quod
interuallum complectitur vnam octauam cum tritono. Vnde
si sonus fundamentalis fuerit G, sequens futurus erit *cis*, qui

items.quote: vnde patet angulum $\Phi$ vix vnum gradum superare, ita vt sit $\omega = 3\varrho + 1^\circ$ circiter.
items.english: Whence it is clear that the angle Φ scarcely exceeds one degree, so that ω = 3ϱ + 1° approximately.

items.quote: manifestum est hic iterum dari valorem tantillo minorem quam $5\varrho$; defectus enim aliquot minuta prima non excedet.
items.english: It is evident that here again there is a value very slightly less than 5ϱ; for the deficit will not exceed a few minutes of arc.

items.quote: in octavo autem reperietur $\omega = 7\varrho$, tam prope vt excessus sentiri nequeat; sicque valores vlteriores erunt continuo exactius $\omega = 9\varrho$, $\omega = 11\varrho$, etc.
items.english: In the eighth quadrant, however, ω = 7ϱ will be found, so closely that the excess cannot be perceived. Thus the further values will be ever more exactly ω = 9ϱ, ω = 11ϱ, etc.

items.quote: proximus vero ad hunc rationem tenebit vt $25:9$, quod interuallum complectitur vnam octauam cum tritono.
items.english: The next sound will stand to the fundamental in the ratio 25:9, an interval comprising one octave plus a tritone.

items.quote: Vnde si sonus fundamentalis fuerit G, sequens futurus erit *cis*, qui ergo sonus simul auditus valde ingratam dissonantiam referet.
items.english: Hence if the fundamental sound is G, the next will be C-sharp, which, when heard together with it, will produce a very unpleasant dissonance.
